page.overview:
Who is Brock?

Brock serves as the Gym Leader at the Pewter City Gym. He holds the Boulder Badge for the trainers who defeat him in a Pokémon battle. Brock specializes in and only uses -type Pokémon in the core series.

Brock is a teenager with brown spiky hair and his eyes naturally appear closed. In , he is shirtless and wears a pair of blue jeans and black shoes. In , Brock wears a green vest with a black T-shirt with white short sleeves, brown jeans, and green sneakers (as shown in the corresponding artwork). In , he wears a long-sleeved orange shirt with black lining over a black v-neck shirt and green pants.

Brock, in personality, is quite determined, evident from his nickname “The Rock Solid Pokémon Trainer!" He strongly believes in willpower and determination, and boasts about this fact consistently. He is arrogant and prone to underestimating opponents, especially when it comes to the defenses of his Pokémon, but he still seeks and enjoys a good battle. He is much more respectful to his opponents after the confrontation, and he is able to admit to his faults, specifically the underestimation of his opponent.

Brock finds comfort in areas surrounded by rock and visits Diglett's Cave. This preference expands to Pokémon as well. He believes rock type Pokémon can be cute, but he also sees them as the embodiment of determination due to their rock-hard exteriors.
